container_details.notes: Brand-wide Polymaker announcement dated 2021-08-15 covering all Polymaker filaments (it also states that "filament production has ceased on all plastic spools"); PolyMide is a Polymaker line. Not product-specific: the CoPA product page lists 0.75kg spools but does not state the spool material or its recycled share.
container_details.source_quote: Moving forward, Polymaker will produce all filaments on a 100% recycled cardboard spools.
